title: Oracle Evening Brief
script_summary:
Bitcoin closed the US session at sixty-five thousand two thirty-two, up one point one percent, even as fear and greed sank to twenty-five extreme fear. 

Hashrate remains elevated at nine hundred eleven exahashes while the mempool sits heavy at eighty-seven thousand transactions with fees at just two sat per vbyte. Block height reached nine hundred fifty-eight thousand nine hundred fifty.

Key takeaway: price resilience is holding despite capitulation signals in sentiment. Watch for overnight vo
